title: Lawn Care Preventive Maintenance Checklist Form
subtitle: Control mowing, cultivation, irrigation review, treatment, and property handoff through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete lawn care preventive maintenance checklist for turf zones, plantings, irrigation features, and service equipment. It connects service plan, product label, site map, and instructions to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a qualified lawn-care technician or applicator must perform scheduled lawn care maintenance against an identified plan while preserving readings, defects, deferrals, verification, and the next due event.

sections.title: Lawn Care preventive service tasks and controlled materials
sections.guidance: Separate tasks completed from tasks merely considered, and preserve product, part, quantity, and removed-item custody.

blocks.label: Preventive maintenance tasks completed
items: Mow to the approved height and pattern
Edge approved hardscape and bed boundaries
Trim around obstacles without property damage
Collect or distribute clippings as authorized
Aerate, dethatch, seed, or topdress approved zones
Apply label-consistent fertilizer or control product
Adjust or report irrigation condition
Remove approved debris and restore gates
Photograph material property or plant condition
Communicate watering, reentry, and next-service instructions

sections.title: Lawn Care measurements and post-maintenance verification
sections.guidance: Use repeatable observations to show the maintained scope reached the stated condition.

blocks.label: Measurement and verification log
blocks.guidance: Applicable measurement concepts include: Turf height before and after, Treated or serviced area, Product rate and applied quantity, Soil moisture, pH, or other approved reading, Weather, wind, or rainfall condition, Irrigation, watering, or follow-up interval.

blocks.label: Post-maintenance condition and function checks
items: All authorized zones received the documented service
Mowing, edging, trimming, and cleanup meet the approved standard
No visible discharge, debris, or damage remains on hardscape or property
Applied product and rate agree with the label and service record
Gates, irrigation controls, furniture, and movable items are restored
People, pets, water, and sensitive areas remain protected
Known plant, turf, drainage, or equipment concerns are documented
Customer received watering, reentry, and next-visit instructions

sections.title: Lawn Care defect containment and corrective-action routing
sections.guidance: A preventive checklist does not release an unsafe, unverified, or out-of-scope condition.

blocks.label: Lawn Care exception and stop-work indicators
items: People, pets, traffic, or property remain in the discharge or work zone
Hidden utility, irrigation, wire, drain, or obstacle location uncertain
Slope, wet ground, drop-off, heat, storm, or lightning condition unsafe
Equipment guard, blade, tire, control, or emergency stop is defective
Product label, qualification, PPE, weather, or application boundary not met
Spray drift, runoff, overspread, spill, or non-target plant exposure
Tree, branch, retaining wall, sinkhole, or structural condition appears unstable
Property line, customer instruction, or protected zone is disputed
Plant damage, disease, or condition exceeds authorized lawn-care scope
Work would conflict with irrigation, construction, occupants, or another vendor
blocks.guidance: Select the observed condition; do not use a generic exception when the actual trigger is known.

sections.title: Lawn Care preventive maintenance checklist closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: This lawn care preventive maintenance checklist is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, licensing, product labeling, manufacturer instructions, site policy, safety requirements, or professional judgment. Stop affected work, access, application, operation, testing, or release when weather, chemical labeling, people or pets, hidden utilities, slope, equipment guarding, property boundary, or treatment condition is uncertain. A turf, pesticide, or safety supervisor must review the exception, authorize the controlling decision, and preserve its evidence before closeout.
